requirements.evidence: Migration matches spec incl. unique (entity_id,email) and cascade (create_entity_invites_table.php:16-24); model normalizes e-mail via Attribute mutator (EntityInvite.php:28-33); sendInvite validates, rejects existing member/pending invite, replaces expired, catches QueryException race, rate-limits after success only (Members.php:49-120); PendingInvites accept is idempotent, 403 for non-invitee, error on 'invite' when expired, firstOrCreate membership, session + redirect (PendingInvites.php:16-56); manager-only mount + route middleware 'can:update,entity' (routes/web.php:56); modals with ui.members_details header and ui.members_remove_title, no empty option. Gaps: race detection by string-matching the exception message (Members.php:254-259) rather than UniqueConstraintViolationException; the members view has no explicit @error('inviteEmail') and relies on <x-input> to render it (covered by a test); e-mail expiry title uses unlocalized 'F j, Y'.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes (invite create/delete, membership create, role update) live inline in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* (Members.php:84-96, PendingInvites.php:34-44); invitee authorization uses abort_unless e-mail comparison instead of a policy (PendingInvites.php:99-105). Positives: #[Validate] on public properties, policies via $this->authorize('update', ...), #[Fillable] mass-assignment, migration with down(), Bulma modals without JS libs, docs (business-rules, database-schema, architecture) and CHANGELOG updated.

security.evidence: Every write action authorizes server-side (sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole call authorize('update')); parameters resolved through entity-scoped relations (invites()->findOrFail, memberships()->findOrFail); saveRole re-resolves selectedMembershipId within the entity (Members.php:242-246) so the unlocked id cannot be tampered across entities; invitee checked by e-mail; output escaped with {{ }}; rate limit present. Minor: confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval have no authorize (UI-state only, Members.php:188-196); selectedMembershipId is not #[Locked].

tests.evidence: Good new coverage: schema, normalization, mail rendering in both locales, invite happy path, invalid input not consuming quota, duplicate/expired replacement, rate limit, single error render, foreign cancel/openMember tamper, saveRole owner/last-manager, accept/decline unauthorized, expired, idempotent, no-duplicate, onboarding <hr> presence/absence, switcher. But the existing tests 'cannot remove the last manager of an entity' and 'cannot remove the owner; managers can remove members' were deleted without replacement although removeMember rules are kept (MembersTest.php old lines 116-154); no test for the unique-constraint race path or for an employee calling cancelInvite/sendInvite directly.

simplicity.evidence: Mostly direct code; pending()/expired() scopes reused. Some extra: unused scopeExpired/isPending/invitedBy helpers on the model besides tests, factory accepted() state not required, duplicated queue-mail test in EntityInviteTest.php:102-120 and MembersTest; redundant trim before and after validation (Members.php:52,59).

readability.evidence: Clear names and comments ('An expired ... invite may be replaced', 'Accepting is idempotent'); small protected helpers (selectedMembership, inviteRateLimitKey). sendInvite is long (~70 lines). Nits: duplicated assertSee('Target Name') in MembersTest; stray blank line in CHANGELOG 'Changed' list.

scope.evidence: All edits serve the task: navbar/dashboard member link hidden for non-managers (default-page.blade.php:44-47, dashboard.blade.php) follows from manager-only members page; docs/CHANGELOG updates are required by conventions.

issues.location: tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTest.php (removed tests 'cannot remove the last manager of an entity' and 'cannot remove the owner; managers can remove members')
issues.explanation: Existing tests covering the retained removeMember rules (never the owner, never the last manager) were deleted and not replaced, weakening the suite.
Domain writes (create invite, accept invite/create membership, change role) are done inline in components instead of one Action class per use case as the conventions require.
Invitee authorization is a hand-rolled abort_unless e-mail check instead of a policy/gate.
Unique-constraint race is detected by substring-matching the exception message instead of catching UniqueConstraintViolationException, which is fragile across drivers, and the path is untested.
No unauthorized-call tests for an employee invoking sendInvite/cancelInvite/saveRole/removeMember directly (only mount is covered).
confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval are public actions without server-side authorization (low impact: they only toggle UI state).
Raw <time> HTML with an unlocalized 'F j, Y' title in a markdown mail; the date format is not localized for pt_BR.
Duplicates the queued-mail assertion already covered in MembersTest with an inline IIFE fixture.
Stray blank line splits the 'Changed' bullet list.

review.summary: The change replaces instant member addition with an invite flow (table, model, factory, queued mail, PendingInvites component, manager-only members page with detail and removal-confirmation modals) and covers nearly all requirements with solid authorization and a broad new test suite. However, it deletes the existing tests for the retained removal rules without replacement, bypasses the project's Actions/policy conventions for domain writes and invitee authorization, and detects the insert race by string-matching exception messages, so it needs changes before merging.
